mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the head and spine to the trunk was most worthwhile because it connected nerve signals and blood supply to the same muscles.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the digestive and urinary organs into named slots was clear but predictable; the main choice was which region to prepare first.

surprise.text: The lymph network lined up with its existing neck-vein junction rather than adding a second one. That made the shared route clearer.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary. The regional slots and later joining goals made the purpose of each fitting clear, though most pairings were straightforward.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter if it explored a new connection rather than just assembling more named parts. The final body brought the earlier work together, but several fittings were predictable.
